title: Exim Bank Management Trainee, Manager Recruitment 2026
summary: Indian Exim Bank has released a Notification on its official website for the recruitment of Management Trainee (MT) / Manager posts. This recruitment is for 120 posts . Exim Bank Application Form will start on 27 November 2026 & the candidates can apply until 11 December 2026 . The Minimum age required is 21 – 24 Years Post Wise & The Maximum Age Is 28 – 30 Years as on 01 November 2026. Candidates must check the complete details for Exim Bank Management Trainee, Manager Recruitment 2026 which has given below. (Advt.No: HRM/ MT/M/ 2026-27/ 05)
qualification: Candidates must have secured minimum 60% aggregate marks or equivalent CGPA in Graduation , which should be a full-time course of at least 3 years duration.
